data.name: Versatile Performance (Wind Instruments)
data.description: You can use your bonus in the Perform (Wind Instruments) skill in place of your bonus in the Diplomacy or Handle Animal skills. When substituting in this way, you use your total Perform (Wind Instruments) skill bonus, including class skill bonus, in place of your Diplomacy or Handle Animal skill bonus, whether or not you have ranks in that skill or if it is a class skill.
